description: Accessibility snapshot: interactive elements with refs to target by `ref` (more reliable than guessing CSS selectors). Pass diff:true to get only what changed since the last snapshot of this tab - far cheaper in a click/read loop. Password fields appear as secret:true with no value.

allFrames.description: Act on the first match in ANY frame (the element may be in an iframe)

diff.description: Return added/removed/changed elements since the previous snapshot of this tab instead of the whole tree

failOnAuthWall.description: Error with [AUTH_REQUIRED] if this lands on a sign-in wall (expired session)

name: snapshot
